english.title: Contravene obligation imposed by control order - Prevention of Terrorism 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the subject of

(A)_[a derogating control order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) ON **(..SPECIFY DATE..)]_
(B)_[a non-derogating control order made by the Secretary of State on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) ]_

without reasonable excuse contravened an obligation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OBLIGATION..), imposed on you, by **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Section 9(1) and (4) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act 2005.
english.pointstoprove:
Existence of a Control Order
Whether derogating or non-derogating
How the obligation was contravened
Date and location
There was no reasonable excuse

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording document was REPEALED by section 1of the Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures Act 2011 as from 14/12/2011

This offence wording should be used where the control order is still in existence.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and / or a a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

NOTE: 6 months imprisonment prior to s154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 coming into force)

INDICTMENT: 5 years imprisonment and /or a fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions
None
